title: Inline base64 LAS request terminates with SIGSEGV
client_value: Binary complex input represented as base64 with explicit media type and encoding.
Multiple requested raster outputs combined with a provider crash.

must: Validate the wrapper and base64 syntax without promising semantic LAS validity.
Preserve both requested output IDs and show the provider detail safely.
must_not: Treat successful base64 decoding as proof that the provider can import the point cloud.
Blame GRID or COUNT output selection from the generic crash message.
Retry or rewrite the request automatically.
